text:
maria: ran a multi-provider perf sweep this morning comparing the same GPU SKU across AWS/GCP/Azure. posting highlights + a couple oddities. :mag:
ryan: sweet, which model / quantization?
maria: eval payload: redwood/rlhf-7b-int8 (per-token latency + max throughput). quantized with our int8 pipeline, KV cache warm. seq_len=512, batch sizes 1/4/16.
de vin: small nit: did you pin driver+cuda? those change perf a lot.
maria: yes — pinned to the most common stacks we deploy:
```
AWS: 470.57.02 + CUDA 11.7
GCP: 470.57.02 + CUDA 11.7
Azure: 535.113.02 + CUDA 12.1 (node image managed)
```
ryan: that Azure driver looks newer. any kernel mismatches?
maria: exact same GPU SKU (A100 40GB in all 3 regions) but Azure nodes have a different kernel + NV driver combo -> shows up in kernel-level nvhost latency.
samir: what did latency distribution look like? p50/p95/p99 numbers?
maria: p50 nearly identical across providers (~18ms/token at batch=1). p95 diverged: AWS/GCP ~42ms, Azure ~65ms. p99: AWS 120ms, GCP 140ms, Azure 320ms.
de vin: ouch for Azure p99. did you capture stack traces / perf counters?
maria: yes — sample traces show frequent memcpy stalls on Azure during KV-cache refill. perf counters show higher L2 miss rate + frequent PCIe-retries on some nodes.
ryan: could this be firmware/BIOS or NUMA config? Azure images sometimes pin CPUs strangely.
maria: we saw different iommu flags and SQ size settings. also observed that our fused attention kernel falls back to the generic kernel on Azure for longer sequence lengths (>=768) — but these runs were 512 so less common.
benchbot: benchmark run 1812349999 completed. attach: s3://bench-results/maria/1812349999/summary.html
maria: throughput-wise: batch=16 saturated AWS/GCP at ~250 tokens/sec/node, Azure peaked at ~160 tokens/sec with higher variance.
samir: did you try a driver downgrade on Azure to match 470.xx?
maria: quick test on a single Azure dev node with 470.57.02 showed p95 drop to ~48ms and p99 to ~110ms — much closer. suggests driver+kernel pairing causing fallback paths.
ryan: OK good reproduce. action items?
maria: 1) run controlled test matrix: driver 470 vs 535 on Azure across 5 nodes to confirm reproducibility (sched for today). 2) collect dmesg + nvidia-smi -q logs for failing nodes. 3) update model onboarding checklist to include driver/kernel matrix for new SKU onboarding.
de vin: add a note to rerun quantized kernel autotune after any driver change — kernels can pick different codepaths.
samir: also add a rule: if p99 > 2x baseline, mark as 'stack-incompatibility' and route traffic away in Dedicated.
ryan: agree. can you put the full raw data + flamegraphs in the bench s3 dir? I want to share with infra.
maria: done. link above + raw tar: s3://bench-results/maria/1812349999/raw.tar.gz
maria: one more: Azure heterogeneity is higher across AZs — some AZs looked fine with 470 drivers preinstalled; others ship with 535. so region-level routing might help until we standardize images.
ryan: thanks — can you open a short runbook with reproduction steps and the downgrade playbook? I'll loop infra.
maria: will do, creating a short doc under internal-runbooks and ping infra in #eng-infra once done.
benchbot: reminder: schedule next nightly sweep for 1812439999 at 03:00 UTC :calendar:
maria: thanks all :thumbsup:
